title: icicle view
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate icicle (slice-and-dice) tree layout with area coloring and labels.

**dataset → input → filter → layout → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkAreaLayout](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkAreaLayout.html) — area layout filter.
- [vtkLabeledDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLabeledDataMapper.html) — labeled data mapper.
- [vtkSliceAndDiceLayoutStrategy](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSliceAndDiceLayoutStrategy.html) — slice-and-dice layout strategy.
- [vtkStringToNumeric](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStringToNumeric.html) — string to numeric.
- [vtkTreeMapToPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTreeMapToPolyData.html) — converts tree map to polydata.
- [vtkXMLTreeReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkXMLTreeReader.html) — xml tree reader.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
